sources.entry: django-anymail - Django email backends and webhooks for transactional email services such as Amazon SES, Brevo, Mailgun, Postmark, and Resend.

summary.one_liner: Anymail is a Django email integration that lets you send and receive email through many transactional email service providers (ESPs) using one consistent API.
summary.what_it_does: Anymail plugs into Django's built-in django.core.mail so you can switch between supported ESPs such as Amazon SES, Brevo, Mailgun, Postmark, Resend, and SendGrid by changing settings rather than code. It supports HTML, attachments, extra headers, and inline images. It exposes ESP-specific features like tags, metadata, and click/open tracking through portable message attributes. It connects ESP webhooks to Django signals to report sent-message status and tracking events. It also provides inbound message handling through ESP webhooks, with simplified access to attachments and other content, and supports batch transactional sends using ESP templates and merge features.
use_cases: send transactional email from a Django app
switch between email service providers without rewriting code
track email delivery and opens or clicks via webhooks
send HTML email with inline images in Django
receive inbound email through ESP webhooks
send batch emails using ESP templates and merge fields
how_to_run: Configure MAILERS (Django 6.1+) or EMAIL_BACKEND and ANYMAIL (Django 6.0 or earlier) with your ESP's backend and API credentials
Send mail with django.core.mail.send_mail or EmailMultiAlternatives
notable: One Django email API across 14 supported ESPs, switchable via settings
Normalized sent-message status and tracking events delivered as Django signals
Portable extensions for tags, metadata, and tracking across ESPs
Inbound email support via ESP webhooks with simplified attachment access
Simplified inline image attachment helpers for HTML email
caveats: SendGrid is listed as no longer tested
Each ESP needs its own account, API credentials, and sometimes extra packages installed via pip extras
Anymail is an independent project not affiliated with any email service provider
keywords: send email from my django site
